text: The reticulum acts as a pump for rumination: it forms feed into boluses and pushes them back up the esophagus to the mouth for re-chewing. Rumination breaks fiber into smaller pieces and aids fermentation. While chewing cud, the cow adds large amounts of saliva (about 50 liters/day), which prevents rumen acidity and supplies urea. A cow may spend 35–40% of each day ruminating.
